ELIHPOEHT TRANSFORMATION

Jul 26, 2026

Elihpoehtify Transformation - Dreamy Wording Update ✨

Overview

The entire user-facing text has been transformed to reflect a more poetic, dreamy, artistic aesthetic aligned with the “elihpoeht” persona—blending digital artistry with poetry and imagination.

Changes Made

🌙 Landing Page

Before:

  • “Modern Digital Solutions & Creative Portfolio”
  • “Scroll to explore”

After:

  • “Where Dreams Code into Reality ✨”
  • “Drift into the cosmos…”

French:

  • “Où les Rêves se Codent en Réalité ✨”
  • “Flottez dans le cosmos…”

🎭 Hero Section

Before:

  • Subtitle: “Front-end Engineering Fanatic”
  • Tagline: “Crafting beautiful, performant web experiences”

After:

  • Subtitle: “Digital Dreamer & Code Poet”
  • Tagline: “Painting worlds with pixels & poetry, building experiences that whisper to the soul”

French:

  • Subtitle: “Rêveur Numérique & Poète du Code”
  • Tagline: “Peindre des mondes avec des pixels et de la poésie, créer des expériences qui murmurent à l’âme”

🖼️ Portfolio Section

Before:

  • Title: “Playground”
  • Subtitle: “My Projects”
  • Description: “Click on a project to view more details”
  • Button: “View Project”

After:

  • Title: “The Ethereal Gallery”
  • Subtitle: “Whispers of Creation”
  • Description: “Step into each realm and discover the stories woven within”
  • Button: “Unveil”

French:

  • Title: “La Galerie Éthérée”
  • Subtitle: “Murmures de Création”
  • Description: “Entrez dans chaque royaume et découvrez les histoires tissées dedans”
  • Button: “Dévoiler”

✨ Featured Projects

Before:

  • Title: “My latest launched projects”
  • Subtitle: “Cool UX/UI for artists”

After:

  • Title: “Dreams Crystallized into Code”
  • Subtitle: “Experiences painted for the soul”

French:

  • Title: “Rêves Cristallisés en Code”
  • Subtitle: “Expériences peintes pour l’âme”

📞 Contact Section

Before:

  • Title: “Get In Touch”
  • Available: “I’m available for JavaScript fullstack and front-end engineering work”
  • CTA: “Let’s get in touch!”
  • Footer: “Made by Théophile Vast with Vue.js & Vite”

After:

  • Title: “Summon the Muse”
  • Available: “Open to collaborations, dreams, and code adventures in the digital realm”
  • CTA: “Let’s craft magic together ✨”
  • Footer: “Woven by Théophile Vast with Vue.js & Vite”

French:

  • Title: “Invoque la Muse”
  • Available: “Ouvert aux collaborations, rêves et aventures de code dans le royaume numérique”
  • CTA: “Créons la magie ensemble ✨”
  • Footer: “Tissé par Théophile Vast avec Vue.js & Vite”

Thematic Elements

Key Words & Phrases Used:

Dreamy/Poetic:

  • Dreams, whispers, poetry, muse, ethereal, magical
  • Painting, weaving, crystallized, realms, soul
  • Cosmic, infinite, enchantment

Technical Blended with Poetry:

  • “Code Poet” - merging logic with art
  • “Pixels & Poetry” - visual + emotional
  • “Digital Dreamer” - imagination in tech

Active & Inviting:

  • “Drift,” “Unveil,” “Craft,” “Summon”
  • Creating sense of mystery and exploration
  • Encouraging user engagement

Tone & Voice

Before: Professional, modern, technical After: Artistic, poetic, mystical, inviting

The transformation maintains professionalism while injecting:

  • ✨ Wonder and imagination
  • 🎨 Artistic sensibility
  • 🌙 Dreamy, ethereal quality
  • 💫 Sense of magic & possibility
  • 🎭 Narrative & storytelling

Visual-Textual Harmony

The new wording complements:

  • Dracula theme colors (mystical, dark, artistic)
  • Particle animations (cosmic, dreamy)
  • Gradient effects (fluid, otherworldly)
  • Typography (Megrim, Poiret One - artistic fonts)
  • Liquid CTA button (organic, flowing)

Accessibility Notes

✅ All text remains clear and readable ✅ Poetic language doesn’t obscure meaning ✅ Translations maintain tone in both EN/FR ✅ CTAs still clear and actionable ✅ Metaphors are intuitive

Implementation

All changes made in:

  • src/locales/en.json - English translations
  • src/locales/fr.json - French translations

No component changes needed - i18n system handles all dynamic text.

Results

The portfolio now feels:

  • 🌟 More artistic and unique
  • 💭 More memorable and engaging
  • 🎪 Less corporate, more creative
  • ✨ Aligned with “elihpoeht” aesthetic
  • 🌊 Flowing and poetic

Perfect for attracting collaborators who appreciate art, creativity, and the intersection of technology with imagination!

Optional Enhancements (Future)

  • Add animated text effects on hero
  • Subtle poetic quotes rotating on homepage
  • Easter eggs with elihpoeht references
  • Animated poetry in about section
  • Dream-like particle effects on scroll
